about: T-598 PLAY A DAEMON'S SONG AND IT COMES (DRAFT, every pixel; no words): its opening played on the HARP in freestyle, on its key's wheel, and the daemon appears two tiles off, flickers in, turns to the player and sings its own part whole (its notes rising from its mouth), says its QUOTATION (none yet: T-599) and walks on, flickering out. Never caught, never a battle; its SUMMONED bit is set. ROVERCUB (GROWTH, F major: F wheel, 3 5 3 2 1 6 6 5 3), HUNCH (CONTEXT, A minor: on C's wheel, 6 1 4 1 5 4 3 2), and ROVERCUB's opening on the wrong wheel (C), which brings nothing. The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved. Watch held at day, clear weather.

stops.stop: ROVERCUB's opening on F's wheel: it comes, sings, and goes
steps: shot "gone; the field is the player's again"
